{"response":{"responseId":"vtOKafWpJ7KE_uMP2eOQeQ","modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":515,"promptTokenCount":5839,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5839}],"thoughtsTokenCount":5912,"totalTokenCount":12266},"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  \n  // Basic checks as per existing Kissat implementation\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // The described algorithm utilizes 'solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts' and LBD trends.\n  // In Kissat, this mechanism corresponds to the \"focused\" mode. \n  // Stable mode uses Reluctant Doubling (checked here to preserve solver integrity).\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve Exponential Moving Averages (EMA) of the LBD\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Compute the trend ratio R = Fast_EMA / Slow_EMA\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow \u003e 0.0)\n    R = fast / slow;\n\n  // Step 3: Determine a dynamic multiplier M\n  double M = 1.0;\n  if (R \u003c 0.85)\n    M = 1.4; // search quality is rapidly improving -\u003e extend the run\n  else if (R \u003e 1.15)\n    M = 0.7; // search quality is degrading -\u003e curtail the run\n\n  // Step 4: Retrieve the solver's scheduled restart conflict limit\n  const uint64_t limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  // Step 5: Trigger a restart (return true) only if the current conflict count \n  // exceeds the scheduled limit multiplied by M.\n  const double threshold = (double) limit * M;\n\n  // Logging for verification and debugging\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"dynamic restart check: R=%.2f (fast=%.2f/slow=%.2f) \"\n                            \"M=%.2f conflicts=%\" PRIu64 \" limit=%\" PRIu64 \" threshold=%.1f\",\n                            R, fast, slow, M, CONFLICTS, limit, threshold);\n\n  return (double) CONFLICTS \u003e threshold;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}],"role":"model"},"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP"}]},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
